newsitem.title: POLAND: Peugeot-Citroen unit sells PLN 19 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot-Citroen unit sells PLN 19 mln CPs.

text.p: The Polish unit of Peugeot-Citroen sold 19 million zlotys worth of one-month commercial papers to domestic investors, said the Polish unit of Societe Generale, a dealer of the firm's commercial paper programme.

Slawomir Komonski, deputy treasurer at Societe Generale in Warsaw told Reuters the bank placed four million zlotys worth of papers maturing on February 3 and 15 million zlotys worth of papers maturing on February 6 with domestic investors.
"Their yields are higher than those of comparable maturity T-bills on the secondary market," said Komonski but declined to give precise figures.
The instruments come from Peugeot-Citroen's two-year commercial paper programme started in December 1995 with maximum outstanding debt set at 30 million zlotys.
